intro.text: A Southern Scadrian who crewed the Brunstell.

items.text: Svel and Allik served together on the Brunstell, and both had a hand in a shipmate being dangled overboard for fumbling the cistern three-step. Svel was aboard when the ship went down in a storm in 342 PC. When Allik was freed from the Set, he spotted Svel's mask on the prison wall and knew Svel had died a captive.
